title: Nebulus

tools.emulator: VICE / vice-mcp v3.14.0, macOS arm64 headless, dummy audio

accuracy.note: Completed the resident image ledger in the follow-up.

exclude: Second screen page swapped by $AB5F. The authored contents from hand-over are preserved at $1C00-$1FFF.
Mutable VIC pattern page generated by $AC6A. The pristine source is preserved in $D000-$D7FF.
Sprite output from $B44B and $ACE5. Source frames at $4000-$527F and $E000-$EFFF.
Runtime tile columns and underwater strips. The map decoder at $B043 and the scene pattern generator at $A01D repurpose this RAM after hand-over.
Columns 8 to 11 of the runtime tile grid expanded by $B043.
Final three columns of the runtime tile grid expanded by $B043.
Sprite record pointers generated in RAM at $BD01.
Sprite mask work page cleared by $BCEF.
Column 12 of the runtime tower grid expanded by $B043. The alternate C128 path at $ABC9 uses its first eight bytes as trampoline space.
Retained packed loader stream. Replaying the decoder at $0100 on this stream reproduces $FAA0-$FDFF byte for byte. The resident game installs its RAM vectors over the stream's final bytes.
6510 port and zero-page workspace. Game logic uses this page for mutable scene state, pointers, counters and flags.
include: Pristine character and tile backup in RAM under I/O, restored to $7800 by $A280

io: The C64 path banks I/O out before restoring patterns and setting the CPU IRQ vector.
